notes.title: “Stonegeon” Early Access is now on sale!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers, "Stonegeon" Early Access is finally released today!
Thanks to the adventurers for waiting for many days, there will be a 20% discount for the first one week, come and adventure together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42374088/859c77fcd86d7374158d101f22385a7263043065.png[/img]

Time and again deep into the dungeon, defeat monsters, collect resources, make equipment, the goal is to pass all the dungeons and constantly improve yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42374088/eab66ee1c0b8284c3e0649ff1b9c16b20d1789ef.png[/img]


The game is still in the Early Access stage, if you encounter Bug in the game, please feel free to submit to us
Bug submission email: gundamwzc@163.com

notes.title: The Early Access version of "Stonegeon" will be launched on October 27th! !
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!

The Early Access version of "Stonegeon" will be launched on Steam on October 27th, welcome adventurers into the dungeon to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42374088/5a95f978652599377cecb2c45d27b4fec65691af.png[/img]

In the ancient ruins, a special magic circle leading to the dungeon suddenly appeared one day, and people attracted by the dungeon soon gathered in this ruins. As one of the adventurers attracted to the dungeon, can you survive the battle with the powerful monsters in the dungeon and explore the secrets hidden in the deepest part of the dungeon?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42374088/29a3c37d38efa1055172af192efcc4f2fc07de6d.png[/img]


The game is still in the Early Access stage, if you encounter Bug in the game, please feel free to submit to us
Bug submission email: gundamwzc@163.com
